english.title: Use a vehicle (non-motor vehicle) on a road with lamp used to cause undue dazzle / discomfort
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..), on which

(A)_[a lamp fitted to the vehicle was]_
(B)_[lamps fitted to the vehicle were]_

used to cause undue dazzle or discomfort to other persons using the road
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
(ii) This offence document and code should be used only in relation to a non-motor vehicle (e.g. a bicycle). The offence in relation to a motor vehicle is PNLD document H6547 (RL89171)
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when

(A)_[a lamp fitted to the vehicle was]_
(B)_[lamps fitted to the vehicle were]_

used to cause undue dazzle or discomfort to other persons using the road.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of a vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
